description: LCVEX AArch64 Linux Flash image contract. Flash aperture and payload offset are planning candidates; platform RTL does not yet implement this aperture.

format.checksum: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC; descriptor CRC covers header and segment table; each segment CRC covers its complete DDR load span

flash.source_offset_semantics: absolute byte offset from the start of EPCQL flash
flash.hex_address_semantics: relative to the beginning of the payload BIN; COF adds payload_offset exactly once

bram.composition: standalone Linux loader replaces the resident B25 monitor image for a Linux configuration; it does not link the monitor or CoreMark
